name: REFF: model27's reference filter, a one-pole lowpass on every track whose sound chose it
description: The smallest filter package (the track filters, notes/72 §10): it proves the filter slot before a real filter uses it. The audio block's call of Volume + Dist goes to the builder's part (tools/machines/fltslot/), which calls REFF on each track whose sound chose id 255, after Volume + Dist. REFF is a one-pole lowpass whose pole follows k 28 and an attenuation that follows k 29, restarted by a note. Never offered to users.

uses.name: REF Filter
uses.why: a filter of the filter slot: called after Volume + Dist as (block, k 28 to k 31, track, triggered) on the tracks whose sound chose id 255

unchanged: every track whose sound has not chosen REFF
